lessons: Premise false: the `override` spike is counted only in `production_evidence` (clutch/retro.py:247, `invoices[check.key].bypassed` from a `git show` of each checks invoice), not in `measurements(window)`. A pure no-I/O `due_trigger` cannot see it.

The criteria contradict each other: 'trigger kinds unchanged', a pure `due_trigger` with no I/O, and 'no `production_evidence` before trigger on unforced calls' cannot all hold while `override` is a default-enabled SpikeKind (config.py:24, 244).

A human must rewrite the ticket and pick one: (a) record `bypassed` in the journal from the Check stage and count `override` in `measurements`, fencing that path; (b) accept dropping or deferring the `override` trigger and update compatibility and docs; (c) state an override-only evidence fallback.

The serve half of the diff (`check_retro` called only from the `Serve.run` loop, with the dis-based site test) passed review. A rewritten ticket can keep that scope unchanged, or split it into its own ticket that lands independently.
